one_liner: Donovan Mitchell scores 28.2 points per 36 minutes on 36.7 percent three-point shooting across 195 games.
three_things: 28.2 points per 36 is among the top scoring rates in this set.
The shooting supports it: 36.7 percent from three, 85.1 percent from the line.
He adds 6 assists and 5.1 rebounds per 36.
context_note: Per-36-minute rates over a 3-season sample (seasons_played: 3), not per-game and not full-career figures. The manifest is descriptive_only: no adjustment for opponent, teammates, role, or shot difficulty, and a career_min_minutes>=800 inclusion floor applies. Games and minutes measure availability, not how well those minutes were used.
